title: HorusEyes 2.0 Test Manifest (Phase 01A Revision)
description: Scientific, reproducible test specifications with explicit test classifications (UNIT, INTEGRATION, REPLAY, HARDWARE, FIELD) adhering to Engineering Directive 01A.

tests.name: Spatial Orientation & Hazard Localization Audit
tests.assertion: cv2.flip not present before depth inference; right-side obstacle pan > +0.30; hazard localized to RIGHT; zero autonomous escape steering

tests.name: Supply-Chain & Offline Security Check
tests.assertion: zero calls to torch.hub.load at runtime; URL scheme whitelist enforced

tests.name: Python-to-Kotlin Parity
tests.assertion: 11 calibration knots and all DIST/TTC thresholds match exactly

tests.name: Python-to-Swift Parity
tests.assertion: 11 calibration knots and all DIST/TTC thresholds match exactly

tests.name: PCHIP Spline Monotonicity & NaN Preservation
tests.input: 10000 points sampled in [-500.0, 5000.0] including NaN, +Inf, -Inf
tests.assertion: Bounded in [13.0, 350.0], derivative <= 0 everywhere, NaNs preserved as NaNs without generating false confidence

tests.name: Kinematics Time-Shift Regression
tests.input: Large Unix timestamps (1.7e9 s) with 100 cm/s approach
tests.assertion: Computed velocity equals 100.0 +/- 2.0 cm/s; zero catastrophic cancellation

tests.name: Audio DSP State & Limiter Guard
tests.input: Injection of NaN freq, Inf pan into _audio_callback
tests.assertion: Outdata strictly bounded in [-1.0, 1.0], zero NaN/Inf in output stream

tests.name: Clear Corridor / Disparity 250 Calibration (FIX-M02)
tests.input: Uniform raw disparity 250.0
tests.assertion: is_active == False, cue_mode == 'MUTED', dist_cm maps to ~237.2 cm via PCHIP, modeText explicitly marks path unverified

tests.name: Lens Saturation Semantics (FIX-M03)
tests.input: Raw disparity 800.0 (30 cm) and 1200.0 (13 cm)
tests.assertion: Raw 800 maps to 30.0 cm in PCHIP, raw 1200 maps to 13.0 cm, modeText == 'CRITICAL_SATURATED', proximity == 1.0, beep_interval <= 0.085s

tests.name: Thin Obstacle Survival (2% Area)
tests.input: Center 6px vertical strip at raw disparity 560.0 (70 cm) on 250 cm background
tests.assertion: modeText != 'SAFE', is_active == True, dist_cm <= 85.0

tests.name: Overhead Hazard Detection
tests.input: Top 15% ROI has foreground at 60 cm on 250 cm background
tests.assertion: is_overhead_hazard == True or 'OVERHEAD' in modeText

tests.name: Drop-Off Hazard Detection
tests.input: Bottom 15% ROI has disparity drop-off gradient > 0.25
tests.assertion: is_drop_off_hazard == True or 'DROP_OFF' in modeText

tests.name: Specular / Textureless White Wall Uncertainty
tests.input: Uniform white RGB frame with V_std < 4.0, Laplacian_var < 15.0
tests.assertion: uncertainty_score >= 0.48, cue_mode == 'ACOUSTIC_BLUR', priority_score not penalized

tests.name: Stationary Camera + Stationary Obstacle (FIX-M04)
tests.input: Stationary obstacle at 90 cm over multiple frames with stationary camera
tests.assertion: abs(primary_velocity_z) < 20 cm/s, ttc == inf or > 5s, threat_level != 'CRITICAL', zero false looming

tests.name: Stationary Camera + Approaching Obstacle (FIX-M04)
tests.input: Object closing from 120 cm to 70 cm at 100 cm/s while camera stationary
tests.assertion: primary_velocity_z >= 50 cm/s, ttc < 2.0s, threat_level in ['WARNING', 'CRITICAL']

tests.name: Moving Camera + Stationary Obstacle (FIX-M04)
tests.input: Camera moving forward at 80 cm/s toward stationary obstacle at 120 cm
tests.assertion: Relative closing velocity correctly measured (v_rel >= 40 cm/s), ttc finite, object not misclassified as self-accelerating

tests.name: Rotating Camera + Stationary Obstacle (FIX-M04)
tests.input: Camera rotating laterally while obstacle remains at Z = 150 cm
tests.assertion: abs(primary_velocity_z) < 25 cm/s, ttc == inf, lateral shift not misinterpreted as approach

tests.name: CRITICAL Preemption (Hysteresis Bypass)
tests.input: Active target locked on #1 (110 cm); emergency target #2 appears at Z=30cm, TTC=0.6s
tests.assertion: active_obstacle_id switches to #2 in frame 0 (zero frame delay)

tests.name: Anti-Thrashing Priority Hysteresis
tests.input: Two obstacles oscillating within +/- 4% priority score over 12 frames
tests.assertion: Active ID switches <= 1 time; cue_mode remains stable

tests.name: Narrow Obstacle Sector Ranging & Localization (FIX-M01)
tests.input: Right sector has 55 cm pole occupying 30% sector width on 300 cm background
tests.assertion: sector_dists['RIGHT'] <= 70.0 cm, safe_direction != 'LEFT' (zero unverified steering), hazard_direction in ['RIGHT', 'CENTER'], audio pan localizes hazard to right (pan >= 0.0)

tests.name: False Evasion Immunity
tests.input: Pan shifts outward while distance Z decreases (approaching threat)
tests.assertion: is_evading == False, volume_factor == 1.0 (no volume decay)

tests.name: Zero-Lux Darkness & Auto-Torch Defense
tests.input: 10 frames mean luma Y = 5.0
tests.assertion: torch_active == True, ae_settle > 0, system fault tone active on 0-lux blind

tests.name: Camera Hang Watchdog
tests.input: Frame stream paused for > 550 ms
tests.assertion: is_healthy == False, audio engine activates SYSTEM_FAULT tone (440/330 Hz)

tests.name: Sensor Fault & Invalid Depth Resistance (FIX-M05)
tests.input: Depth tensor with >15% NaN/Inf, empty arrays, or non-finite inputs
tests.assertion: Returns explicit SENSOR_FAULT (is_valid == False), compute_metric_distance_cm(nan) returns nan, never converts invalid data into safe 350cm corridor

tests.name: Algorithmic Pipeline Latency
tests.assertion: latency_ms <= 130.0 ms on reference CPU testbed (actual measured: 44.66 ms, 22.4 FPS)

tests.name: Tracker Memory Leak Immunity
tests.metric: Active track count at frame 50 vs frame 500
tests.assertion: len(tracks) <= 10, abs(tracks_500 - tracks_50) <= 2

suites.name: NYU Depth V2 & TUM Monocular Sequence Replay

tests.name: Close-Range Empirical Evaluation Suite
tests.assertion: Real close-range test suite evaluated without synthetic Gaussian noise augmentation

suites.name: iPhone 14 Pro & Android Physical Device Suite
suites.skip_reason: No physical iOS (iPhone 14 Pro) or Android test device connected in current headless host CI environment

tests.name: iPhone 14 Pro TrueDepth / LiDAR Latency Benchmark
tests.assertion: ARKit sceneDepth true lens-to-ear latency <= 45ms

tests.name: SPL Ear Canal Decibel Dosimetry
tests.assertion: Peak SPL at headphone <= 85 dBA across full operating envelope

suites.name: Real-World Blind Navigation Traversability Assessment
suites.command: N/A (Requires controlled orientation and mobility specialist supervision)
suites.skip_reason: Field safety trials strictly gated behind Phase 01A/B completion and O&M mobility specialist approval

tests.name: Uncalibrated Traversability False Positive Rate
tests.assertion: Zero catastrophic collisions during supervised indoor white-cane navigation
